en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a heavily damaged waterfront city block. A large multi‑storey building, identified as the Olympe(s) Hotel, stands in ruins with its façade gutted and interior exposed. Surrounding structures on the quay are also partially destroyed. In the background are additional damaged buildings and a domed structure with a statue or finial. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe the scene, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.
